Do not substitute idle poses and do not redraw an action.

Repair only the missing canonical equipment. The paladin has exactly ONE compact gold warhammer with rectangular red-inset head, at the character's anatomical RIGHT hip (PICTURE LEFT in front view), and exactly ONE small red/gold cross holy book at anatomical LEFT hip (PICTURE RIGHT in front view). Keep the book already present; do not duplicate it or replace action props with it. The cat/flowers/lantern may occlude the lower hammer head; show only physically visible attached portions. Do not move hammer to the other waist to make it visible. All sixteen human cells need the same single hammer and existing right book.
